purpose: Test one model change selected by V62: retain the complete V56 bounded-mixture model and objective, and add only 0.1 times a source-balanced q99.9-backbone conditional log physical-moment mismatch that directly targets the locked train-gate functional.

single_model_change.retained_V56_objective: bounded NLL plus 0.1 times the four fixed V54 physical-tail Brier scores plus 0.1 times the original byte-bound 16-cell V56 upper survival-grid score
single_model_change.added_term: 0.1 times the arithmetic mean over TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift of 0.5 times squared ln(predicted conditional mean delta squared divided by exact target conditional mean delta squared)
single_model_change.mask: for each source, physical backbone plus immutable target mean greater than or equal to that source's sealed q99.9 train-probe boundary
single_model_change.predicted_moment: 64-point differentiable Gauss-Hermite expectation of (exp(4.5 ln(10) y)-1)^2 under the unchanged bounded mixture, averaged over the source mask
single_model_change.truth_moment: exact float64 (exp(4.5 ln(10) y)-1)^2 averaged over the identical immutable train-target mask

sealed_q99_9_backbone_boundaries.source: byte-bound V61 train-only gate; identical to the earlier V56/V53 train-only boundaries

unchanged_model_and_training.likelihood: V56 five-component bounded-logit Gaussian mixture on open standardized residual support [-13.78839653180272, 10.259036149654781]
unchanged_model_and_training.network: V56 LocalMixtureUNet with 8490415 parameters and all seven condition channels
unchanged_model_and_training.optimizer: AdamW learning rate 2e-4, weight decay 1e-4, cosine schedule to 2e-5, gradient-norm clip 1.0, AMP, and EMA 0.999
unchanged_model_and_training.batch: one uniformly selected immutable train object from each of TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift
unchanged_model_and_training.augmentation: the same uniformly selected 48 signed cube isometries applied jointly to all conditions, target, backbone, and therefore the moment mask

hard_preflight.real_batch: object zero from each immutable train source with signed cube isometry index 7
